findings.title: Temporary-table harness still executes persistent archive CREATE
findings.trigger: Run fixture()+build_sql on a database where persistent question_content_revision does not exist.
findings.effect: A persistent empty question_content_revision table is created despite the temporary table shadow and test no-persistent-mutation claim. No question data leak was found.
findings.evidence: MySQL 8.0.46 check_if_table_exists only looks for temporary table when ha_lex_create_tmp_table is true; ordinary CREATE checks persistent dictionary. Existing local table predates these independent tests.
findings.suggestedFix: In test-only execution, omit the archive CREATE already covered by temporary fixture, while keeping production SQL unchanged.
findings.resolution: Root removed exactly one persistent archive CREATE from test-only SQL, asserts its presence, and reuses filtered SQL for repeated run. Production SQL unchanged. Independent rerun passed.

independentDatabaseTests: missing classification row with fallback baseline inserts exact classification and reruns safely
explicit rollback restores both content and classification and removes archive insert

limits: No writes to persistent question data; SQL exercises used temporary shadows over preexisting archive schema.
